t: The $(item)Logistics Configurator's/$ primary purpose is to help out with configuring a $(l:logistics/overview)Logistics System/$.$(p)By $(thing)right-clicking/$ it on any $(l:logistics/frames)Logistic Frame/$ it can configure various filters.$(p)$(thing)Sneak right-clicking/$ removes the frame from the inventory it's attached to.
$(item)物流配置器/$的主要用途是帮助配置$(l:logistics/overview)物流系统/$。$(p)在任意$(l:logistics/frames)物流框架/$上对它$(thing)右击/$，即可配置各种过滤器。$(p)$(thing)潜行右击/$可将该框架从其所附着的容器中移除。

The $(item)Logistics Configurator/$ can also be used to remove (by $(thing)Sneak right-clicking/$) other attachable gadgets, such as the $(l:semiblocks/transfer_gadget)Transfer Gadget/$ and the $(l:semiblocks/crop_support)Crop Support/$.
$(item)物流配置器/$也可以用于移除其他可附加的小装置（方法是$(thing)潜行右击/$），例如$(l:semiblocks/transfer_gadget)传输装置/$和$(l:semiblocks/crop_support)作物架/$。
